title: ML-TFHP: Mittag-Leffler Tempered Fractional Hawkes Process Library for High-Frequency Quantitative Finance
description: A high-performance Python package and reproduction library for Mittag-Leffler Tempered Fractional Hawkes Processes (ML-TFHP). Unifies volatility clustering, anomalous memory, and fast O(NM) state-space recursive likelihood inference in high-frequency financial markets. Includes Basel Committee FRTB Expected Shortfall risk backtesting, multi-horizon event forecasting, and bivariate order-flow estimation.
